hub_unsupported: This hub doesn't support avatars yet. Update the hub and check again.
states_label: {name} in five states: idle, thinking, working, needs you, offline
missing: The chosen avatar isn't on the hub right now, so the default is shown. It switches back automatically when it returns.
none: No other avatars on the hub yet. Install an extension that comes with avatars in {extensions}.
upload_label: Upload an image as an avatar
delete_body: This avatar will be removed from the hub and from all your devices.
delete_body_current: This avatar will be removed from the hub and from all your devices. It's the current avatar, so Persona goes back to the default one.
